ESV.2: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you, for I have yet something to say on God's behalf.
ESV.3: I will get my knowledge from afar and ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
ESV.4: For truly my words are not false; one who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
ESV.5: “Behold, God is mighty, and does not despise any; he is mighty in strength of understanding.
ESV.6: He does not keep the wicked alive, but gives the afflicted their right.
ESV.7: He does not withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne he sets them forever, and they are exalted.
ESV.8: And if they are bound in chains and caught in the cords of affliction,
ESV.9: then he declares to them their work and their transgressions, that they are behaving arrogantly.
ESV.10: He opens their ears to instruction and commands that they return from iniquity.
ESV.11: If they listen and serve him, they complete their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasantness.
ESV.12: But if they do not listen, they perish by the sword and die without knowledge.
ESV.13: “The godless in heart cherish anger; they do not cry for help when he binds them.
ESV.14: They die in youth, and their life ends among the cult prostitutes.
ESV.15: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction and opens their ear by adversity.
ESV.16: He also allured you out of distress into a broad place where there was no cramping, and what was set on your table was full of fatness.
ESV.17: “But you are full of the judgment on the wicked; judgment and justice seize you.
ESV.18: Beware lest wrath entice you into scoffing, and let not the greatness of the ransom turn you aside.
ESV.19: Will your cry for help avail to keep you from distress, or all the force of your strength?
ESV.20: Do not long for the night, when peoples vanish in their place.
ESV.21: Take care; do not turn to iniquity, for this you have chosen rather than affliction.
ESV.22: Behold, God is exalted in his power; who is a teacher like him?
ESV.23: Who has prescribed for him his way, or who can say, ‘You have done wrong’?
ESV.24: “Remember to extol his work, of which men have sung.
ESV.25: All mankind has looked on it; man beholds it from afar.
ESV.26: Behold, God is great, and we know him not; the number of his years is unsearchable.
ESV.27: For he draws up the drops of water; they distill his mist in rain,
ESV.28: which the skies pour down and drop on mankind abundantly.
ESV.29: Can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds, the thunderings of his pavilion?
ESV.30: Behold, he scatters his lightning about him and covers the roots of the sea.
ESV.31: For by these he judges peoples; he gives food in abundance.
ESV.32: He covers his hands with the lightning and commands it to strike the mark.
ESV.33: Its crashing declares his presence;  the cattle also declare that he rises.

AMP.2:
"Bear with me a little longer, and I will show you,
That there is yet more to say on God's behalf.
AMP.3:
"I will bring my knowledge from afar,
And will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.
AMP.4:
"For truly my words are not false;
He who is perfect in knowledge is with you.
AMP.5:
"Behold, God is mighty, and yet does not despise anyone [nor regard any as trivial];
He is mighty in the strength and power of understanding.
AMP.6:
"He does not prolong the life of the wicked,
But gives the afflicted their justice.
AMP.7:
"He does not withdraw His eyes from the righteous [those in right standing with Him];
But with kings upon the throne
He has seated them forever, and they are exalted.
AMP.8:
"And if they are bound in bonds [of adversity],
And held by cords of affliction,
AMP.9:
Then He declares to them [the true character of] their deeds
And their transgressions, that they have acted arrogantly [with presumption and notions of self-sufficiency].
AMP.10:
"He opens their ears to instruction and discipline,
And commands that they return from evil.
AMP.11:
"If they hear and serve Him,
They will end their days in prosperity
And their years in pleasantness and joy.
AMP.12:
"But if they do not hear and obey, they will die by the sword [of God's destructive judgments]
And they will die [in ignorance] without [true] knowledge.
AMP.13:
"But the godless in heart store up anger [at the divine discipline];
They do not cry [to Him] for help when He binds them [with cords of affliction].
AMP.14:
"They die in youth,
And their life ends among the cult prostitutes.
AMP.15:
"He rescues the afflicted in their affliction,
And opens their ears [so that they pay attention to His voice] in times of oppression.
AMP.16:
"Then indeed, He enticed you from the mouth of distress and confinement,
Into a broad place where there is no constraint or distress;
And that which was set on your table was full of fatness (rich food).
AMP.17:
"But you [Job] were full of judgment on the wicked,
Judgment and justice take hold of you.
AMP.18:
"Do not let wrath entice you into scoffing;
And do not let the greatness and the extent of the ransom turn you aside.
AMP.19:
"Will your wealth [be sufficient to] keep you from [the confinement of] distress,
Or will all the force of your strength do it?
AMP.20:
"Do not long for the night,
When people vanish from their places.
AMP.21:
"Take heed and be careful, do not turn to wickedness,
For you have chosen this [the vice of complaining against God] rather than [learning from] affliction.
AMP.22:
"Behold, God is exalted in His power;
Who is a ruler or a teacher like Him?
AMP.23:
"Who has appointed God His way,
And who can say [to Him], 'You have done wrong'?
AMP.24:
"Remember that you should magnify God's work,
Of which men have sung.
AMP.25:
"All men have seen God's work;
Man looks at it from a distance.
AMP.26:
"Behold, God is exalted, and we do not know Him;
The number of His years is unsearchable.
AMP.27:
"For He draws up the drops of water,
They distill rain from the mist,
AMP.28:
Which the clouds pour down,
They drop abundantly upon mankind."
AMP.29:
"Can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds
Or the thundering of His pavilion?
AMP.30:
"Behold, He spreads His lightning around Him [against the dark clouds],
And He covers the depths of the sea.
AMP.31:
"For by these [mighty acts] He judges the peoples;
He gives food in abundance.
AMP.32:
"He covers His hands with the lightning,
And commands it to strike the mark.
AMP.33:
"His thundering voice declares [awesomely] His presence;
The cattle also are told of His coming storm.
